title: Absolute's Warboard
summary: The Absolute’s Brand grants +1 to saving throws with this shield. Cast Heroism as an Action once per Long Rest to prevent Frightened and grant 5 temporary HP each turn while active.

fields.Effect: The Absolute’s Brand grants +1 to saving throws.
fields.Base value: 70 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.
fields.Heroism: Action once per Long Rest. Touch yourself or an ally. Concentration, up to 10 turns. The target is immune to Frightened and gains 5 temporary HP each turn. Temporary HP do not stack.

changes: Reconciled the item and linked gameplay rules with their pinned BG3 Wiki revisions, including item-specific qualifiers.
